chapters.title: Fiona's path from chemistry to PowerPoint
Fundamentals: alignment tools, grouping and the Selection Pane
SmartArt, shortcuts and the Quick Access Toolbar
Copilot in PowerPoint: strengths and limits
Delivery tools, storytelling and quick-fire round

takeaways: Many PowerPoint problems come from using one deck for different purposes: a handout read as a PDF needs a different design from slides that support a live speaker.
Long-standing fundamentals such as the alignment tools, grouping, the Selection Pane, SmartArt conversion and the Quick Access Toolbar save time even for experienced users.

Copilot and Designer work best with a robust corporate template with many layouts and image placeholders, and Copilot is especially useful for structuring ideas, finding hooks and endings, and anticipating audience questions.
hook: Most professionals use PowerPoint every day but miss features that have existed for years. In this interview, PowerPoint MVP Fiona Walsh shows presenters, template owners and Microsoft 365 users which fundamentals, template practices and Copilot techniques make presentations faster to build and clearer to deliver.
